hypothesis: The dominant remaining text bottleneck is the forced single SurfaceRegion summary. A globally trained three-slot query-independent codebook should preserve the official multiview teacher set and its held-out generic-text retrieval geometry better than the frozen single-summary V2 control.

representation.reason: The frozen cache contains at most three official teacher views; K is matched to that authority and is not swept.
representation.core_semantics: only core tokens construct the summary-token base
representation.context_semantics: separately normalized context conditions a gated residual

training.train_scenes: 32 disjoint ScanNet scenes from the four frozen context_c1024_geometric train shards
training.validation_scenes: 8 disjoint ScanNet scenes from the two frozen context_c1024_geometric validation shards
training.input_tokens: 256 published tokens deterministically stratified from up to 1024 surface candidates
training.set_matching: exact masked permutation minimum over K=3
training.set_cost: descriptor cosine loss + 0.25 * summary-token cosine loss
training.scene_objective: equal mean of standardized listwise KL, teacher top1-runner-up gap SmoothL1, teacher-set relation-tercile-balanced SmoothL1, and slot-prior anti-collapse KL
training.loss_weighting: 3-epoch set warmup, then independent-response and scene branches each receive 0.25 of the main gradient norm from one deterministic warm-start calibration
training.seed_policy: run seed0 canary first; run seeds1/2 only if seed0 passes structural and generic gates

generic_gate.control: seed-matched frozen SurfaceRegion V2 on the identical validation cache and held-out generic dev text bank, recomputed against the same multiview latent teacher response
generic_gate.multiseed_requirement: mean gate passes and at least two of three seeds win teacher-best-slot and response SmoothL1

benchmark_opening_rule.full_lerf_gate: four-scene macro improves at least 0.01 and no scene drops more than 0.01
benchmark_opening_rule.spin9_nvos_gate: frozen strict result is noninferior within 0.002 before any claim of shared-task improvement
